title: He came back at night. The kingdom remembered.
look: cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, smooth stabilized gimbal, steadicam and crane camera movement, shallow depth of field, dark moody night grade, deep blacks, fire orange highlights and teal shadows, drifting smoke and embers, film grain, photorealistic, vertical 9:16, no text. The hero is exactly the man in the starting photo, the same face, beard, sunglasses and black clothes in every shot: an original fictional man, not any real actor: in his late 40s, tall and broad-shouldered, South Indian, short grey-streaked black hair swept back, a full neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a thin scar through his left eyebrow, black aviator sunglasses, a black linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, black trousers, black leather boots, a steel watch on his left wrist and a thin black thread on his right wrist, calm, heavy, powerful presence
negative: cartoon, anime, CGI, 3D render, text, watermark, blur, shaky handheld camera, celebrity, famous actor, real person, different person, different face, different clothes, coloured shirt, suit jacket, clean-shaven, upside down, extra limbs

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up at ground level: a black leather boot steps down off the last metal stair of a private jet onto rain-wet tarmac, a splash, smoke rolling across the ground, night

Wide slow push-in: a sleek black private jet on a rain-wet airstrip at night, fog, runway lights, its door open with a single dark silhouette of a broad man standing at the top of the stairs, no face visible
Close-up, slow push-in: he slowly raises his sunglasses and slides them on, half his face in shadow, he looks into the lens
Low-angle slow-motion steadicam shot pulling back as he walks straight towards the camera, black SUVs with headlights behind him, smoke swirling around his boots
Smooth tracking shot as he walks past, men in black clothes standing in a line on both sides of him lower their heads as he passes
Close-up, very slow push-in on his face, a flame reflected in his sunglasses, a drop of rain runs down the lens, he does not blink
Aerial drone shot at night: a convoy of black SUVs with headlights drives slowly through the arched gate of an ancient South Indian stone fort lit by rows of burning oil lamps, smoke rising
Smooth steadicam shot pulling back as he walks slowly towards the camera through the courtyard, villagers holding fire torches step back to both sides to make way
Medium shot: an old village woman in a white saree steps forward and holds his hand, he gently places his other hand on his heart and lowers his head to her
Side tracking shot in slow motion as he walks across the courtyard, embers drifting, saffron flags flapping in the wind, torchlight on his face

Wide shot at the far end of a torch-lit stone fort courtyard at night: a group of tough men in white shirts and white dhotis holding long wooden sticks drop their sticks to the ground one by one and step back, fear on their faces
Close-up: he slowly tilts his head, the faintest smile at one corner of his mouth, torchlight flickering
Medium shot: he slowly raises one open hand, palm out, and everyone around him freezes in silence, the torches flicker
Extreme close-up: he slowly takes off his sunglasses with his right hand, his intense dark eyes look straight into the lens, upright normal framing
Low-angle hero shot: a huge wall of fire erupts along the stone fort wall behind him, every villager raises their burning torch high and roars, he stands still
Smooth crane shot rising up and back: he stands at the centre of the courtyard as hundreds of villagers with fire torches fill the fort around him
Slow push-in from a low angle as he sits still on the carved stone seat, torches below him, smoke drifting across
Close-up: he slowly slides the sunglasses back on, smoke drifts across his face, he looks into the lens
Very slow push-in on him standing still on the rampart, the wall of fire below, a huge full moon, embers rising, his silhouette dark against the light

description:
Years ago his own land sent him away. Tonight a black jet landed, and the whole kingdom came out with fire in their hands.

Music: Kingdom (main title theme) by ÆTHER, an original score. An original AI-made character, made as a tribute to the black-shirt mass hero style of Malayalam cinema. Turn the volume up.
